lines.text: The LORD tells Isaiah not to fear what the people fear, because only the LORD of Hosts should be feared.
To both houses of Israel the LORD will be a stone of stumbling, and many will fall and be broken.
Isaiah says people should consult their king, not mediums, and those not speaking by the word roam hungry.
God humbled Reuben and Naphtali in the past, but a great light has dawned on the people in darkness.
A child is born, the government will be on His shoulders, and He will reign on David's throne.
